newsitem.title: USA: Barnes & Noble Q4 same-store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Barnes & Noble Q4 same-store sales rise.

text.p: Barnes & Noble Inc said same-store sales for its superstores, including store relocations, increased 8.7 percent for the fourth quarter and 7.3 percent for the year.

The company also said its total sales for the quarter rose 22 percent to $882.5 million, from $722.5 million last year. For the year, the company said its total sales were $2.448 billion compared with $1.977 billion in 1995.
Total superstore revenues rose 38 percent to $1.861 billion from $1.350 million for the year and contributed 76 percent of revenue compared with 68 percent in 1995.
The New York-based bookseller said that excluding relocations, its same-store sales rose 5.7 percent for the quarter and 5.2 percent for the year.
Same-store sales for the company's mall bookstores, excluding store closings, fell 3.3 percent for the quarter and 1.0 percent for the year, the company added.
